name: YogaHub Bristol
notes: Membership-tiered studio (8 classes a month for 76 GBP, unlimited online). Social club culture - runs walks and trips, so lots of footage.

name: Yoga Bristol (Charlotte)
address: Redland Church Hall, Redland Green Road and All Saints Church Hall, Clifton
notes: Runs fixed 8-9 week courses priced 120-135 GBP. Course-start deadlines are a perfect promo-video trigger.

name: Mindful Lives
address: Bristol (plus retreat centre in the Pyrenees)
notes: Restorative yoga, one-to-one treatments and Thai yoga massage, plus residential retreats abroad. Retreat promo video is high-value. NOTE: their site prints this mobile in the same block as a French (+33) number and a shared email; if it does not connect, reach Claire-Louise at mindfullives.bristol@gmail.com.

name: COMO Shambhala Urban Escape
address: COMO Metropolitan London, 19 Old Park Lane, London
notes: Award-winning Mayfair hotel spa with a 24-hour gym. Corporate procurement, premium budget.

name: Heavenly Spa by Westin
notes: City of London hotel spa with pool and fitness studio. Corporate clientele - lunchtime-offer content angle.

name: E Life Health Centre
notes: Open 10am-10pm seven days, walk-ins welcome. Covent Garden location - tourist-heavy footfall.

name: Healing Hands Therapies
notes: Open Mon-Sat 8-6 and Sunday 8-2. Deep tissue and restoration massage. Solo-style clinic, mobile-first contact.

name: GlowMama
notes: Specialist pregnancy, postnatal and post-operative massage plus reproductive reflexology. Clear niche with an underserved audience.

name: Clinic 31 Sports Massage
address: The Green House, 205 Gibb Street, Birmingham
notes: Sports massage plus hijama cupping in the Custard Factory area. Distinct treatment niche.

name: Bristol Hypnotherapy & CBT
address: Central Bristol (10-15 min walk from Cabot Circus)
notes: Offers hypnotherapy and CBT together. Mobile and Gmail only - very light marketing setup.

name: Bristol Hypnotherapy (Sarah Mortimer)
address: The Harbourside Practice, 3 Redcliffe Parade East, Bristol
notes: Site says 'call or text' 07851 307062 - textable number. Runs a free 15-minute chat and a newsletter called The Hypnoticle. Has media coverage.

name: In Good Hands Wellbeing
address: Thornbury, Bristol (covers Yate, Bradley Stoke, Chepstow, South Gloucestershire)
notes: Unusual combination: sports massage, CBT and hypnotherapy, plus workplace wellbeing. Three distinct audiences.

name: Inhale Exhale Studio
notes: Open 6:30am-9pm weekdays. Email obfuscated on the listing - capture from the studio website or in the first call.

name: We Are Wellness
notes: Headingley wellbeing centre offering yoga and therapies. Phone verified; email needs capturing from the website.

name: The Yoga House Leeds
notes: Open until 8:30pm weekdays, with weekend classes. Email obfuscated on the listing - capture via the website.
